## Summary

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or improved.

## Type of Contribution

- [ ] New exercise (with module assignment)
- [ ] New script/tool
- [ ] New cheat sheet / notes
- [ ] Improvement to existing content
- [ ] Documentation fix
- [ ] Other

## Module

Which course module is this related to? (e.g. Module 4 — Security Operations)

## Motivation

Why would this be valuable for a cybersecurity learning repository? What skill or concept does it demonstrate?

## Proposed Implementation

If you have a specific idea for how it should be implemented, describe it here. Include:
- Language (Python, Bash, etc.)
- Key features or functionality
- Any libraries or tools it would use

## Additional Context

Any references, links, or examples that could help.
